info.name: Substrate API Sidecar accounts rc blocks API
Get a range of relay chain blocks by their height.

params.name: range
params.description: A range of integers. There is a max limit of 500 blocks per request.

params.name: eventDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every event will have an extra `docs` property.

params.name: extrinsicDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic will have an extra `docs` property.

params.name: noFees
params.description: When set to `true`, no fee information is calculated.

params.name: useEvmFormat
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic's event emitted by pallet-revive will have the address data formatted to EVM.

items.docs: Given a range query parameter return an array of all the relay chain blocks within that range.

info.name: Get all parachain inclusion information for a relay chain block.

params.name: blockId
params.description: Relay chain block identifier, as the block height or block hash.

params.name: paraId
params.description: Optional parachain ID to filter results. When provided, only the inclusion information for the specified parachain will be returned.

items.docs: Returns all decoded parachain inclusion events (CandidateIncluded) for a relay chain block from the relay chain API. BlockId can either be a block hash or a block height. This endpoint extracts and decodes the candidate descriptor, commitments hash, and parachain header information for each included parachain block.
